name: L-2-ヒドロキシグルタル酸尿症

summary.text: L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria is a primarily neurological form of 2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria characterized by psychomotor retardation, cerebellar ataxia and variable macrocephaly or epilepsy.
